title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - William L. Winston, Education Consulting LLC - Talent / Human Resources Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and William L. Winston, Education Consulting LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to ensure that partnership with colleges and universities for new teacher recruitment and pipelines are developed and maintained through development of Memorandums of Understanding, including Initiating contact with the designated staff at the college responsible for the MOU, communicating with the college and university partners about the MOU process, the writing of the MOU, and the negotiation of the MOU content, receiving approval from the District’s Legal Department, submitting and tracking the MOU through the approval process, via Talent / Human Resources Department, for the period of July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $10,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $10,000 for Winston Education Consulting to build college partnerships for teacher hiring
summary: A consulting firm will develop and maintain partnerships with colleges and universities to recruit new teachers. That includes writing and negotiating memorandums of understanding (MOUs) with each school and getting them approved by the district's Legal Department. The cost is up to $10,000 for July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022.
vendor_name: William L. Winston, Education Consulting LLC
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Memorandum of Understanding - OUSD STEM Teacher Pathway and Mentor Fellow Project 2021-22 - Trellis Education - Talent/Human Resources Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Memorandum of Understanding - OUSD STEM Teacher Pathway and Mentor Fellow Project 2021-22 by and between the District and Trellis Education, San Francisco, CA for the latter to provide program development and mentoring in the Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) Teacher Pathway and Mentor Fellow Project, as described therein, for the period July 1, 2021, through June 30, 2022.
headline: Approves Trellis Education partnership to build a STEM teacher pathway and mentor fellowship
summary: Under a memorandum of understanding (MOU), Trellis Education will provide program development and mentoring for the district's science, technology, engineering and math (STEM) teacher pathway and mentor fellow project. The agreement runs July 1, 2021 through June 30, 2022. The text does not state a dollar amount; the funding source is listed as a state teacher-credentialing residency grant.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Design For Equity LLC - Madison Park Academy (Upper Campus)
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Design For Equity, LLC, Oakland, CA, for the latter, over a ten (10) month period, in consultation with the school site team, to provide transformative professional learning experiences to the facility and staff to build individual and group capacity to interrupt and change inequitable teaching practices, policies and structures and shift the culture of the school toward creating greater racial equity and belonging, as described in Exhibit A, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, at Madison Park Academy (Upper Campus), for the period of August 11, 2021 through May 11, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $25,000.00.
headline: Ratifies $25,000 for Design For Equity's teacher learning on racial equity at Madison Park Academy
summary: Design For Equity LLC will lead professional learning for staff at Madison Park Academy (Upper Campus) over ten months. The sessions aim to change teaching practices, policies and structures that are unfair and build a school culture of racial equity and belonging. The cost is up to $25,000 for August 11, 2021 through May 11, 2022.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Hanna Interpreting Services, LLC - Special Education Department

summary: Hanna Interpreting Services will provide interpreting by phone and video, document translation and pre-scheduled appointments, arranged through the Special Education Department. The cost is up to $20,000 for July 1, 2021 through July 31, 2022. The text does not say whether the services are only for students with Individualized Education Programs (IEPs).
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
